paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 7.6, representing a 6.74 percent increase from the prior close and a 20.44 percent increase over the past 23 sessions. There have been 11 new news articles about the company in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include articles from Barchart.com, StocksToTrade, and TechStock², discussing the company's securing of a binding customer lease for Project Matador, a 15-year agreement worth about $6.5 billion in contracted revenue, and the resulting surge in stock price. Other articles mention a framework agreement with Hillcore Energy Capital to develop a 2.6-gigawatt power complex at the Project Matador campus in Texas.

There have been 25 total filings, including one Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include an 8-K form disclosing the appointment of new officers, an 8-K/A form regarding the resignation of director Miles Everson, and an 8-K form announcing the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031.
